# Kosha public dataset catalog

> Public-tier datasets of the kosha dataset manifest — title, license, size and format per dataset, for machine consumption.

Generated from the kosha dataset manifest `data/manifest/datasets.json` (https://github.com/gasyoun/kosha); public tier only — intermediate and restricted datasets are deliberately excluded. Regenerate with `python tools/gen_llms_txt.py --catalog <kosha-checkout>/data/manifest/datasets.json` `--out data/llms_catalog.txt`; verify byte-stability with `--check`.

## Datasets
